sideEffects: REGRESSION from the P4-RT-04-03 change (SPEC 7.4 'Copy link always encodes the current state'; SPEC 6.6). On a lesson opened from a link for the leader, a reader action inside a linkTo follower that drives the leader is never written for the leader. The click lands in the follower's frame, so the leader (opened from the link, not acted on) stays waiting: stateChanged returns early and the leader's changed flag stays false. Example: /modules/m5-weyl/?b1.w=1, then a jumpRow click (row 10) in b2's 'Show as table'. The page shows b1 and b2 at 3 moves (1.2.3). The bar becomes '?b1.w=1&b2.z=1&...&b2.w=1.2.3', and reopening it shows b1 and b2 at 1 move. Copy link on b2 gives the same wrong link (reopened at 1 move against 3 on the page). Second example: /modules/m1-mutation/?b1.w=2.1, then a garden jumpRow to the start. The page shows b1 at 0 moves, but the bar stays '?b1.w=2.1' (a replaceState is still issued) and reopens at 2 moves. Base 967118d writes both correctly ('?b1...b1.w=1.2.3&b2...b2.w=1.2.3'; on M1 the bar is cleared). The same flows without a link pass on both builds. No test covers this, and the fixer's known-limit notes do not mention it.

Minor, from the same change: a follower's change after the reader moves its leader is not written while another instance's link still waits, or when the follower came with its own link keys. Examples: M6 ?b1.w=2&b11.w=1 with b11 hydrated, and M1 ?b1.w=2&b3.w=1 with b3 hydrated, write no b2 keys. M1 ?b1.w=2&b2...&b2.w=2 keeps the stale b2.w=2 while b2 shows 2.1, where the base writes b2.w=2.1. Reopening still shows the same state, because followers follow the leader. An instance opened from a link that the reader never touches keeps the waiting state for the life of the page.

Test weakness, minor: in katex-font-preload.spec.ts the claim 'every preload is used' cannot fail here. The headless Chromium in this environment logs no 'preloaded but not used' message: an injected unused preload produced no Log, console or Audits entry. A preload is always fetched, so the equality between fetched fonts and preloads cannot detect an unused one either. I checked preload use with @font-face status instead (all used).
